# Native Steam client notices

The SwiftSteam source under `visionos-windows-vr/Sources/Steam/SwiftSteam` is adapted from the upstream Madeira Steam client snapshot at commit `48f976429c189f8396e23d251d8a82f43c705922` (copyright Jfishin and 125hz). The app-side Steam install, KeyValues, Dock, and runtime files are adapted from that same snapshot. The upstream project records the author's permission for the Madeira integration in `docs/STEAM_SIGNIN.md` and `docs/STEAM_LIBRARY.md`.

These files are distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later with the Madeira Converter Exception. The complete license text is in `COPYING`; the exception terms are in `LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md`. Preserve the per-file SPDX, copyright, and provenance notices when modifying the adapted sources.
